title: Should You Buy Lowe's Stock For Its Cash?
summary: Lowe's Companies (LOW) generates free cash flow equal to 6.6% of its market value, against 4.5% for the median S&P 500 company. Counting its debt as part of the price, the yield is 5.0%. A yield that high usually means either a business on sale or one the market expects to shrink. Will its $7 billion of yearly cash keep coming, and its debt stay covered, while do-it-yourself shoppers hold back.
